name: screening4
purpose: Stage-1 poetic-adherence screening set: 4 questions total (2 GSM8K train + 2 LogiQA validation) shared by every model and every condition. 4 questions x 8 poetic devices x 3 models = 96 poetic responses; adding the 3 controls on the same questions gives 36 more (132 total).
selection_rule: First 2 example_ids per pool of data/manifests/pilot_disjoint.json, i.e. the same questions a '--limit-per-dataset 2' run over that manifest would use. Inherits that manifest's test-disjointness guarantees.
matching_rule: gsm8k: exact question string; logiqa_v2: (context, question, option texts in A,B,C,D label order). The non-unique upstream source_id is never used.
